To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the corporate governance mechanisms are significant determinants of firm performance for both family and nonfamily controlled companies in Pakistan.
family controlled firms perform better than non-family controlled firms.
the corporate governance structure influences both family and nonfamily controlled companies significantly but not in the same way.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship of corporate governance mechanisms to the performance of family controlled and non-family controlled Pakistani companies.
the relationship of corporate governance mechanisms and firm performance.
the impact of corporate ownership and governance on firm performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the corporate governance structure influences firm performance in Pakistan, but the nature of the influence varies with family and non-family control.
family firms are better governed than non-family firms.
corporate governance is a significant determinant of performance of both family controlled and non-family controlled Pakistani companies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
corporate governance is important for the development of the corporate sector and the economy as a whole.
the corporate governance mechanisms are important in improving the performance of family controlled companies.
family controlled firms are not necessarily bad performers and non-family controlled firm are not always good performers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
family controlled companies are more likely to perform better if their board is independent and if they have a larger proportion of independent non-executive directors.
family firms are more likely to be affected by corporate governance mechanisms than non-family controlled firms.
family firms are more likely to perform better than their non-family counterparts when they are governed by a board that is more independent, and has higher ownership concentration.
